scope: Matched spatial M1/M2 without explicit frequency branches, with M3 retained; native160 and fixed reference16. Primary attribution: guided minus control. Auxiliary comparisons: each after minus its shared before. Control is CE + 0.1 KL, intervention coefficient 0 and useful all False: no intervention-selection loss. Its teacher_original reuses the existing original scores from the same source-fitted teacher. Guided adds the original intervention-selected margin_floor at coefficient 0.3683066666126251. This estimates the incremental selected-guidance training procedure, not selection alone or a physical mechanism. Both continuations use the matched source fit and order, planned 6 epochs/54 steps on adapt136, fit1205 separate. Seeds 17/29/43 vary training order with the SAME initialization, NOT independent initializations. Development160 and expanded3075 are historical cohorts, NOT blind tests. OA/BA are percentages; differences are percentage points. BA averages present classes only. NLL uses natural logs; Brier sums over eight classes; SD is sample SD across the three order seeds. Pass bootstrap conditions on fixed fitted models; repeated seeds, vessels and references are not independent evidence. Protocol statements describe the supplied design; raw training receipts are retained, not inferred from logits. Generated native cases remain not_reviewed until the main agent inspects them.
